title: Helped a SaaS team take its regulated pipeline from architecture to Alpha
summary: In a cross-team group, I worked with the SaaS team to take its DevOps pipeline from architecture to a working Alpha, with the design history file and test automation built into the pipeline.
what_would_have_happened: In the project lead's words, the SaaS team alone could not have reached a working pipeline in two program increments.
the_call: Build the design history file and test automation into the pipeline from the start.
what_i_did: Worked closely with the team on the architecture and the Alpha release, and on the evaluation that recommended the best-rated continuous delivery tool.
what_changed: A working master template pipeline was released as the Alpha, and the project lead named me among its main contributors.

quotes.text: Without this fusion team, SaaS team as a single entity would not have been able to achieve the same in a span of 2 PIs.
